description: Converts the model's point loads (or a coordinate table) into dispersed patch loads with the Point to Patch Convertor's engine and writes them as PATCH_<case> load cases: plate decks get pressures on the plates the patch covers, grillages get UDLs on the members by the lever rule, total force conserved; units converted to the model's. The writer snapshots every row it touches, writes, and reads every item back with a force-equilibrium check. Previews unless apply: true.

acceptBlockers.description: Accept OVERRIDABLE blockers (the plugin's "Write anyway") — only with the user's agreement.

active.description: Elements the patches may load: { groups: [names], useZ, zMin, zMax }.

alphaS.description: Half-angle from vertical through the surfacing, ° (0 is honoured).

b0.description: Contact width across the traffic, m (null = the preset's).

l0.description: Contact length along the traffic, m.

neutralAxisDepth.description: m below the top, for NEUTRAL_AXIS.

presetId.description: Contact area and spread rule (EN 1991-2, UK NA, CS 454, BS 5400, Network Rail…; point_to_patch_read lists them with their clauses).

tc.description: Slab depth, m (apply: default the plate thickness).

mode.description: REPLACE rewrites the PATCH_ cases (and removes earlier ones it does not reproduce); ADD writes new ones beside them.

tag.description: Added to the case names: PATCH_<case>_<tag>.

source.description: mode MODEL (default: nodal and beam concentrated loads; lcNames to pick cases, owners, minMagnitude) or MANUAL (manualText: one load per line 'X, Y, P[, Z]' in kN and m; manualCase names the case).

name: point_to_patch_apply
title: Disperse point loads into patch loads
